messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired - autoscaling-critical - p99 latency > 1.2s in us-east-1 for model redwood-2-large (pool: ded-pool-3). metric: inference.p99=1243ms, p95=310ms, error_rate=0.6% ; PagerDuty: PD-INC-8712
pagerduty: Page triggered and routed to primary on-call (sam). If unacknowledged in 8m will escalate to rohit.
sam: ACK - looking. grabbing logs and current pool state. tagging @jen in case we need manual routing.
jen: thx. see recent deploys? any rollout to ded-pool-3 in last 20m?
rohit: I see a spike in request concurrency to redwood-2-large from a single customer namespace (cust-arc). could be hotkey or batch size regression.
sam: pulling traces: one hot path shows KV cache misses ramping at 15:02:13 UTC and bursty token counts. attaching short logs: ```[2026-03-15T15:02:12Z] req=abcd user=cust-arc seq_len=2048 batch=8 kv_miss=true latency=1320ms pool=ded-pool-3```
mia_support: Support queue: 2 customer reports from cust-arc saying "timeouts" and "very slow responses" since ~15:01 UTC. Notified them of ongoing investigation.
jen: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce batch size for ded-pool-3 for this model to 1 2) lower routing weight for ded-pool-3 to 0.15 so other pools absorb traffic 3) warm KV cache for hot prefixes. I'll run the route override now.
sam: executing short commands: ```rctl pools scale ded-pool-3 --concurrency 0.6 && rctl route override --model redwood-2-large --from ded-pool-3 --to ded-pool-2 --weight 0.15 --reason "p99 spike"``` ETA change < 30s.
ops-bot: Route override applied by jen (id: rv-98321). New weights: ded-pool-3=0.15, ded-pool-2=0.6, hosted-fallback=0.25.
rohit: good. also start a KV cache prefill for top prefixes from trace. command: ```tools/cache-prefill --pool ded-pool-2 --model redwood-2-large --prefix-file s3://ops/hot_prefixes_2026-03-15.txt```
jen: started prefill job (job=pf-772). expect cache hit rate to improve in ~45s.
sam: changing per-route batching config to max_batch=1 for redwood-2-large on ded-pool-3. ```config apply --route redwood-2-large --pool ded-pool-3 --max_batch 1 --min_tokens 8```
incident-bot: Pager update: 4m elapsed. p99 in us-east-1 down from 1243ms -> 840ms. overall p95 stable ~320ms. If p99 stays <900ms for 5m, will mark degradation mitigated.
mia_support: customer cust-arc responded: "we see improvement" but still 2x slower than baseline. They've paused bulk jobs.
rohit: monitoring queue lengths. ded-pool-3 queue dropped after routing change. p99 across pool ded-pool-2 holding ~420ms. looks like cross-region routing helped.
jen: also found an autoscaler anomaly where ded-pool-3 didn't scale because of a scoring bug. filed ticket ops/auto-scale-298 and temporarily bumped pool target to +2 GPU cards to relieve pressure.
sam: bumped capacity: `rctl pools set-capacity ded-pool-3 --gpus +2 --reason "temp mitigation"`
ops-bot: Capacity change accepted, provisioning started (prov-id: prov-556). expected ready ~3m.
pagerduty: PD-INC-8712 acknowledged by sam at 2026-03-15T15:05:10Z. Escalation timers paused.
jen: observations: root cause hypothesis - sudden high concurrency from cust-arc with large sequences triggering KV cache coldness + autoscaler not responding because of scoring threshold edge-case. Plan: 1) let prefill finish, 2) keep reduced routing weight, 3) revert faulty scoring tweak in canary if present, 4) follow up with cust-arc for request pattern.
rohit: agree. I'll own postmortem if we confirm autoscaler scoring bug. assigning to eng-infra.
sam: quick customer impact note for status page: "Partial latency degradation in US-East affecting some customers using redwood-2-large. Mitigation in progress; no data loss. Next update in 30m or on major milestone." I'll open status.incident/PD-8712.
mia_support: added note to PD-8712: affected customers = cust-arc (high), cust-labs (low). ETA for full recovery unknown.
incident-bot: Update: p99 now at 510ms in us-east-1; p95 300ms; error_rate stable. Monitoring for 10m to close.
jen: starting a safe rollback of the last canary that touched autoscaler thresholds (deploy: infra/autoscaler v1.9.4 -> v1.9.3) via canary rollback tool. ```deploy rollback --canary infra/autoscaler --to v1.9.3 --wait```
ops-bot: Rollback initiated by jen (deploy-id: rb-441).
sam: handing over to rohit at 15:45 UTC for next 1.5hr rotation. Summary for handoff: mitigations applied (route override, batch size down, cache prefill, +2 GPUs), p99 improved from 1243ms -> 510ms, customers notified, ticket ops/auto-scale-298 opened. Please follow until prefill completes and prov-556 finishes.
rohit: taking it. will watch for any regression when prov-556 completes and when we remove the route override. will update every 10m or on change.
mia_support: will keep customer-facing updates in PD-8712 and notify CSMs once we move to resolved.
incident-bot: Closing note: pager auto-close timer will not fire until manual close. Marking thread as handed-off to rohit. :white_check_mark:
rohit: quick checklist for follow-up: 1) postmortem draft 2) change to autoscaler scoring with unit tests 3) revisit default batch-size heuristics 4) consider prefix warming for popular customers. I'll start the draft and DM owners.
sam: thanks team. great quick coordination.
jen: nice work all :thumbsup:
